title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode6 Just Like a Ninja

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <Alright, the baton's been passed to our ninth group's second competitor!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to finish in under forty seconds if we still want to keep our hopes of winning alive.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The water spider is going to eat up a lot of my time, so I have to save as much as I can during the high vault...)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Okay, there's the high vault!
Our competitor will need to launch himself over eight layers to succeed.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to get it right the first time if I'm going to post the fastest time possible.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Build up a lot of momentum and...
Three, two, one...)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<A beautiful jump!
He cleared it on his first try!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Yes...!
Those jumping squats really paid off!)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Next, we have the water spider!
In front of our competitor is a pool that's eight meters wide and fifteen meters long!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <He'll need to stand on a pair of special inner tubes in order to cross, with only a pole to help support him. But he's done well so far! How quickly can he finish?!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The straps on these inner tubes are a bit loose. I'll need to keep that in mind...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I want to finish fast, but is it worth taking a big risk? No, don't rush. Slow and steady wins the race!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The waiting area's right next to the water spider stage. I can see clearly see what's happening.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Shinonome's doing...
Good, he's moving at a decent speed...
He's also conserving energy by staying calm.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Two meters to go. I just gotta keep this up and...)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Wait, he's stopped all of a sudden!
Is something wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(What's going on?
He's looking down at his left foot. It's still above the water...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(This is bad.
He'll have trouble just staying standing, let alone moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All he has at this point are his right foot and the pole. How is he supposed to get to the finish line now...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Use the other inner tube as an oar!
Propel yourself forward by pushing against it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (He only has one foot and that pole now, so it won't be easy for him to maintain his balance... But I'm sure he can do this!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I don't have much of a choice at this point...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa!
He's using only one foot!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
But he's staying afloat...
He's using that pole to keep his balance, while using the other inner tube as an oar!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (My foot's going to sink if I lose focus for even a second... I have to carefully shift my weight, while maintaining this posture!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(The other side's right there...!
I just gotta keep this up...!)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<He finished!
Despite what happened, he was able to cross to the other side!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <He's taken the inner tubes off, and is now running towards his teammate!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <Our ninth group's hopes now rest with their final competitor! She's using the momentum her teammate created in order to absolutely fly!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Despite Tenma and Shinonome running into some trouble, we're still in contention. If I do well here, we might just win... No, not might.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(We will win.
I can't let their efforts go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <Alright, she's reached the wall she'll be climbing!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Five meters...
This is very similar to bouldering. I need to choose where to place my hands and feet carefully.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The quickest route to the top is...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, and she's got her route all figured out! She's basically going straight up it!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Isn't that Haruka Kiritani?!
What's she doing here?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha...
Looks like your cover's blown, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: To be fair, we are talking about a former top-flight idol going rock climbing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey! You guys did awesome!
And Haruka looks like she's on a roll!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
She's probably on track to be fastest among all the teams right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Probably.
We might actually be able to win this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I didn't have any issues climbing that wall, so my current time should be pretty good.)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<She's reached the final obstacle!
How much time will she need to clear it?! Let's hope that she doesn't disqualify herself by falling in!>
